notes.title: Update 1.9.0 – Major Economy Upgrades, 7 Days to Die 2.0, and UI Improvements
notes.content:
Updated the "7 Days To Die" mod to support game version 2.0.

The Economy settings now let you set how many points users receive for gifts in TikTok.

You can now view all users and their points in the Economy settings. (Future updates will allow you to manage user points.)

Redesigned the settings screen for a more compact layout; widgets have been moved to a separate section.

The main chat page was rewritten for better performance and stability.

Added short descriptions to widgets for easier understanding.

notes.title: Update 1.8.6 – German Language, 7 Days to Die, and More
notes.content:
Added full German language support for the app and chat voiceover.

Integrated with "7 Days To Die" game \[BETA].

Improved spam filter accuracy.

Added option to display the chat widget on the left or right side of the screen.

Fixed a UI bug causing extra padding for Twitch messages.

Added more explanatory texts to widgets for better usability.

Fixed various UI issues.

Fixed cloud data saving errors.

notes.title: Update 1.8.0 – Disappearing Messages & 7 Days To Die Integration
notes.content:
Added "Temporary Messages" for the chat widget. You can now enable this feature and set how long messages will stay on screen before disappearing.

Created a mod for "7 Days To Die" that allows you to use Economy points to spawn monsters, give supplies, and perform other in-game actions. \[IN DEV]

Fixed various UI bugs

notes.title: Update 1.7.9 – Feature Upgrades, TikTok & Twitch Channel Points, and New Economy
notes.content:
Fixed issues with TikTok connection and message handling. 

Improved the "Top Likers (TikTok)" widget: now you can configure the number of users, vertical/horizontal layout, and left/right alignment. The app also suggests the recommended widget size based on your settings. Added the ability to send test data to preview the widget.

Added support for "Twitch Channel Points"! Find it in "Settings → Actions" Set up rewards on Twitch and get a one-minute notification when viewers use them. You can also set up a widget to display Channel Points activity across all platforms. \[BETA]

Introduced the new "Economy" section \[BETA]. Now users on all platforms can earn points, which can later be spent on streamer challenges, sounds, actions, and more. For now, users can start collecting points, and there's a leaderboard widget for top point earners.

Summarization now allows you to specify the AI’s name and the streamer’s name, providing better context — so the AI knows when chat refers to the streamer or to itself, and can even react to chat messages.

Added new "characters" for summarization \[TESTS].

Improved summarization logic: the AI now better understands chat context and remembers previous summaries.

Fixed various UI bugs.
